d:
This time in 'Guest in the Newsroom' our guest is writer and lyricist Varun Grover who has written many superhit songs including films like Masaan, Superboys of Malegaon, All India Rank. Watch in this episode what Varun said about Prime Minister Modi, standup comedian Kunal Kamra, Shahrukh and Bollywood.
